code='''from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); divider=next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c]==2 for row in grid))
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=2); bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    obj=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2,bg)]
    lo=min(c for r,c in obj); hi=max(c for r,c in obj)
    target=hi+1 if lo>divider else lo-1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h): out[r][target]=8
    return out
'''; exec(code); print(all(transform(demo)[r][6]==8 and all(transform(demo)[r][c]==demo[r][c] for c in range(9) if c!=6) for r in range(24))); ans=transform(g); print([c for c,v in enumerate(ans[0]) if v==8])
